title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Student → StudentGroup / Cohort
architecture_notes: Workday Student uses Student Groups (and Student Cohorts) to tag students for population management: athletes, honors, first-gen, veterans, TRIO, EOP, specific scholarship cohorts. Used for reporting, communication, and service delivery. Equivalent to PS_STDNT_GROUP + PS_STDNT_GRPS.

source_objects.description: A named group/tag and its members. Equivalent to PS_STDNT_GROUP_TBL + PS_STDNT_GRPS.
Student-to-group assignment with effective dates. Equivalent to PS_STDNT_GRPS.
Entry cohort for retention/graduation tracking (e.g., 'Fall 2026 First-Time Full-Time'). Used for IPEDS cohort reporting.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map: athletics, honors, access_program (TRIO/EOP), demographic (first-gen/veteran), scholarship, advising, other.
Null if active. Cast to ISO 8601.
For IPEDS entry cohorts: link to the cohort identifier (e.g., 'FA2026-FTFT').

notes: Some student groups (athletes, TRIO, disability services) carry additional FERPA sensitivity. Cohort assignment drives IPEDS retention and graduation rate reporting.
